seo_description: Learn about MEVCO International, a Lebanon-based company with an international brand distribution vision.
h1_01: A local foundation. A global outlook.
p_01: An independent Lebanese business created to connect international consumer brands with local retail opportunities.
h2_01: Commercial experience meets a focused new ambition.
p_02: MEVCO International is being established by entrepreneurs with business interests spanning industrial trading, healthcare retail, hospitality and fashion.
p_03: Those experiences inform our understanding of customer relationships, everyday operations and the importance of building a trusted reputation.
p_04: MEVCO is a separate venture with its own strategy: to develop a select portfolio of quality international consumer health and personal-care brands for the Lebanese market.
h2_02: How we intend to do business.
p_05: Clear expectations, responsible representation and transparent communication.
p_06: A deliberately selected brand portfolio rather than an indiscriminate catalog.
p_07: Commercial decisions informed by Lebanese consumer and retailer needs.
p_08: Partnerships built around sustainable sales, reorder potential and sound execution.
p_09: Tell us about your product portfolio and objectives for Lebanon. We welcome conversations about potential distribution partnerships.
